scope: Independent normalized thought experiments, NOT Tesla measurements or a simulation validation

ceiling_static_equal_adhesion_weight.conclusion: zero normal tyre load; equality alone does not provide positive grip

ceiling_static_margin.conclusion: positive tyre normal load under simplified static assumptions

wall_insufficient_grip.conclusion: normal adhesion alone is insufficient for stationary/climbing support

upward_thrust_equals_weight.conclusion: downward motion can continue with zero acceleration

offcentre_nozzle_parallel_thrust.conclusion: nonzero position offset alone does not imply torque

off_axis_thrust.conclusion: thrust line misses COM and produces negative-X torque
